attendance.regularization.requested.title: Regularization request: {code} · {what}

attendance.regularization.requested.audience_note: The employee's own Reporting Manager and Team Lead only — never the whole tenant. Company Admin / HR Admin see every pending request in their queue by role reach, not because of this notification.

attendance.regularization.rejected.audience_note: The person who raised the request.
